text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the National Heritage Board (Museum Admission Fees) Regulations.
2. In these Regulations, “museum” means any museum established by the Board under section 11 of the Act or the museum transferred to the Board under section 37 of the Act.

3. The admission fee for any museum shall be determined by the Chief Executive Officer but such fee shall not exceed $10 per person.
[Subst. by S 443/95 wef 30/09/1995]

heading.en: Waiver, reduction and remission of fees

text.en: 4. The Chief Executive Officer may, in his discretion, waive, reduce or remit either wholly or in part any fee payable under regulation 3 in any particular case or class of cases.
